lines.en: I glide slowly along the cloud layer.
Landing, my wings raise a wind.

lines.zh: 我一步步走向场地中央。
lines.en: I stride to the middle of the ground.
My long tail feathers sweep the stone.
I beat my wings up, then settle back.
I circle along the cliff edge.
I cross the clearing slowly.
A faint crackle of charge follows me.
I raise my wings and ride the wind.
The clouds are under my wings.
I stand high, feathers charged.
Clouds gather behind me.
One wing opens slowly.
I wait, and I am patient.
I look toward the storm clouds.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸里有低低的雷声。
lines.en: There's low thunder in my breath.
One beat of my wings and thunder follows.
My talons grip the stone.
I open my beak and make no call.
The sky is heavy; suits me.
Wings folded, I perch on the cloud.
I turn my head slowly to the distance.
A spark jumps between my feathers.
I'm waiting for this wind to rise.

lines.zh: 我飞起来的时候，云会跟着。
lines.en: When I fly, the clouds follow.
I stand firm; the wind can't move me.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住你整片地。
lines.en: My shadow covers all your ground.
I lower my head to see you close.
There's no charge on you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢展开翅膀，让你量一量。
lines.en: I spread my wings for you to measure.

lines.zh: 你抬头，看得见我的眼睛吗？
lines.en: Looking up, can you see my eyes?

lines.zh: 我的叫声会让山谷回响。
lines.en: My call would echo off the valley.

lines.zh: 我偏了偏头，看你手上的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head at what you hold.

lines.zh: 你没跑，我多看了你一眼。
lines.en: You didn't run — I take another look.
I lift a talon, then set it down.
No one was meant to come here.
I watch you without moving for a long while.
The wind passes between us.

lines.zh: 雷在我翅尖上劈啪作响。
lines.en: Thunder crackles at my wingtips.
That carried some weight.
I step back and spread my wings.
I shake the charge off me.
Not pain, only insult.

lines.zh: 羽毛乱了几根，我抖抖翅。
lines.en: A few feathers bent; I shake my wings.
I've read how you fight.
Wind blows the dust away.
I raise my head; the clouds darken.
I can take more.
Holding that out, come closer.

lines.zh: 我没有兴趣，但可以看看。
lines.en: I'm not interested, but I'll look.
What I eat is the wind up high.
Set it down and I'll come look.

lines.zh: 这点东西对我不算什么。
lines.en: That much means little to me.
I lower my head to sniff, then look up.
I nudge it upright with a talon.

lines.zh: 这点东西，换不动我的翅膀。
lines.en: That won't buy my wings.
I'll take it, but I owe you nothing.
Take it back; I don't need it.
You hit me and stagger back several steps.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一展就挡住路。
lines.en: One spread of my wings blocks the way.
You run into my breast feathers.
I barely shift.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上划出声。
lines.en: My talons scrape the ground.

lines.zh: 风把我身边的尘土卷起来。
lines.en: Wind lifts the dust around me.
I turn a little.
If you want through, go around below.
One spread of my wings and the path is gone.
Hitting me is like hitting wind.
Another great bird lands across from me.

lines.zh: 我们的翅膀几乎一样宽。
lines.en: Our wings are nearly the same span.

lines.zh: 我们一起飞到云层之上。
lines.en: We fly together above the clouds.
Thunder rolls between us.
Her feathers carry light too.
We stand side by side on the cliff.

lines.zh: 风声盖过我们所有的言语。
lines.en: The wind drowns our every word.
The nest belongs on the highest rock.

lines.zh: 我们一起俯视整片山谷。
lines.en: We look down over the whole valley.
In this moment, the sky is quiet.
Claws snatch it and carry it high.

lines.zh: 我抛起来，让风替我接住。
lines.en: I toss it and let the wind catch it.
Too light — my talons don't feel it.
It crumbles in my talon.
I drop it off the cliff.
I only wanted to test its hardness.
It fell without a sound.
I've no interest in carrying it off.

lines.zh: 我丢在崖石上，风会收走。
lines.en: I drop it on the cliff stone; the wind will take it.

lines.zh: 它被我的爪子压出印子。
lines.en: My talons left marks on it.

lines.zh: 这片天空归我的翅膀管。
lines.en: This sky belongs to my wings.
I raise my wings and fix on you.
I open this fight.
I crouch, charging.
You look up at the sky — just what I want.
I turn my frame toward you slowly.
The wind begins to blow your way.
I saw your movement.

lines.zh: 云在我背后，随时能落雷。
lines.en: The clouds are behind me; lightning can fall.
I descend and land before you.
My call has already sounded.
Since you came, don't leave.
I choose you as my opponent.
My wings are spread.
I lower my wings and begin.
I see it all clearly from above.
This fight won't take long.
I turn aside to open distance.
I circle overhead.

lines.zh: 我四格宽的翅膀，遮住天。
lines.en: Four blocks of wing blot out the sky.
I calculate the dive angle.
More charge builds in the clouds.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我已经换了位置。
lines.en: You look up; I've moved.
I drop low, then pull up.
I circle once and fix on you.
The height between us narrows.
I circle once, then tighten.
The wind shifts; you stumble.
You're on that stone; good.
One more circle and I come down.
I've seen the landing point.
I climb a little higher.
Below the cliff is nothing; watch your step.
I'm in no hurry; I'm patient.
Charge jumps between my feathers.
I dive, feather tips first.
I open my talons.
Now is the moment to strike.
I dive and drive a talon down.
One wing sweep knocks you away.
My talons seize your shoulder.

lines.zh: 雷光顺着我的羽毛落下。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my feathers.
I lift you up and hurl you down.
This blow comes with a roar of wind.
The ground cracks from the impact.
I land and dust billows up.
You retreat and I take off again.

lines.zh: 我在远处停住，蓄着下一击。
lines.en: I hold off at a distance, charging the next.
The air is full of a burning smell.
I dive once more.
The valley echoes with that one.
I fold my wings and stand.
Thunder arrives first, then I descend.
The thunder comes first, then me.
The Thunderbird, landing on the cliff.
My wings cover half the sky.
I drop straight down from high.

lines.zh: 空气一紧，你知道我来了。
lines.en: The air tightens; you know I've come.
The cliff stones tremble.
I spread my wings and the wind rises.

lines.zh: 这不是自然出现的东西。
lines.en: I'm not something that occurs naturally.
I land on the ground, steady.
Cloud still clings to my feathers.
I lift my eyes to this land.
The sky is mine to patrol now.

lines.zh: 你听见我振翅的声音了。
lines.en: You heard the beat of my wings.
I slowly draw my wings in.
Charge scatters around me.
This place has gone very quiet.
I've come, and I'm in no hurry to leave.
Can this ground hold me?

lines.zh: 我把头抬高，让雷云更近。
lines.en: I raise my head to bring the storm closer.
Fire scorched a few of my feathers.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了，我从云上掉下来。
lines.en: My wing snapped, and I fell from the clouds.

lines.zh: 水压住我的翅膀，我起不来。
lines.en: Water pins my wings and I can't rise.
In the blast light, I'm thrown far.
An arrow lodges at the base of my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的羽间，很麻。
lines.en: The force seeps among my feathers and stings.

lines.zh: 饿到翅膀撑不住我的骨头。
lines.en: Too starved for my wings to lift these bones.
Lightning strikes, and I shine brighter.
No wind here, and no ground.
